questions.stem_text:
An American buys an entertainment system that was manufactured in China. How does the U.S.
national income accounts treat this transaction?

options.A: Net exports and GDP both fall.
options.B: GDP falls and there is no change in net exports.
options.C: Net exports rise and there is no change in GDP.
options.D: Net exports and GDP both rise.
options.E: Net exports rise and GDP falls.

questions.answer_explanation: Correct option: A - Net exports and GDP both fall.
